text:
maya: quick async check — rolling handshake for cascade feature in slice B (2% us-west). what I did: deployed canary bundle, primed KV cache, ran smoke against sample prompts. seen small spike in kv-eviction errors (~0.3%) on two hosts. watching. @alejandro @samir please advise on cb thresholds. :eyes:
alejandro: on it. can you paste the flag key + route? I want to confirm the circuit-breaker config and the qps distribution.
maya: flag key: feature/cascade_v2, route: /v1/generate?model=orbit-v1, slice: canary-B, commit: f9a3d2e. smoke command I ran:```curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"orbit-v1","prompt":"hello"}'```
samir: I see the eviction metric on the host list you sent. likely KV cache GC thrashing when sequence lengths spike. can we reduce max_seq for canary hosts to 1024 for the next hour? low-risk change.
maya: I can toggle that on the nodepool, give me a sec. also: would like ops to hold ramp if errors >0.5% for 5m.
ops-bot: Alert: kv_eviction_rate exceeded 0.5% on canary-B-host-7 at 2951234570 — currently 0.62% — linked to group: infra-canary.
olivia: pinging infra-sre to check host-7. if it's noisy we should shift traffic off that host before ramp.
alejandro: reviewed CB configs — current thresholds: errors>0.5% -> open; latency p50 > 120ms -> open. We might want to add a streak threshold (3 consecutive 1m bins) to avoid flapping.
maya: agreed. adding streak=3 now. toggling max_seq to 1024 on canary pool. deploying change in 30s.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2951234558 started: infra/canary-config (maya). status: in-progress.
maya: change applied, monitoring. starting 10m watch window.
natalie: quick FYI — I queued PR #4821 for a fix that reduces KV eviction by better prefetching; in review now. if we need a hotfix I can prioritize.
samir: nice — if the prefetch helps we can roll to canary in next wave. for now holding ramp until metrics stable for 10m.
maya: copy. will post another update at +10m or sooner if anything changes. thanks all :thumbsup:
